name: Valorant
policy_notice: Valorant requires the kernel-level anti-cheat Riot Vanguard (vgk.sys), TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, and physical x86 Windows. It cannot run in Wine or virtual machines. MacOSGaming strictly blocks launching this game locally. Please use a physical Windows PC.
sources: Riot Games Support: Vanguard Architecture and System Requirements (2024-2026)
